questions_for_mark.question: How do this plan and M4.3b fit: (A) absorb M4.3b's 3D half (U2), loop re-pointed via charter; (B) framework only, loop builds the cards; (C) loop builds M4.3b in today's HUD, migrate later; under every option the M4.3b 'shortcuts M, L and K' and M4.5 'bot through Godot's input layer' rows are amended in the same attended charter edit before the loop starts either
M stays an instant read-only star chart (no commit, no pause); plotting and commit only at the navigation station
Pacing controls (tour pause, skip dwell, skip stage K, Sgr A* finish approach K, warp level) instant or console (edge: time warp is pacing but has no 3D-ship control; cruise speed is a helm decision)
Console presentation: camera dolly and framed panel vs fully in-world interactive screens
Layout: navigation station for all where-the-ship-goes decisions, Voyage console for the guided voyage, Archive terminal, decision_1..3 reserved for M6
Accessibility: press-twice confirm setting, click-to-walk, keyboard Walk-to list

coordination.M4.3b: see Q1; under A, M4.3b's 3D-ship deliverable is U2 and M4.5's scene half starts after U6 using ShipConsoles.use

features.description: demos/ship_consoles.gd (ShipConsoles): stations from ship.glb node names (console_navigation_0..2, console_decision_0..3, archive_terminal); use points via WalkArea.closest_walkable(origin, 2.5) with walked path lengths printed (40 m ceiling); E priority = nearest interactable in reach and facing, lift included, named by the prompt; reach (2.5 m) and facing (60 deg) prompt; E or click to use; 0.6 s camera dolly focus and back; panel host aligned to the console rect; click-to-walk and Tab Walk-to (WalkArea.path, 3.5 m/s, WASD cancels); confirm modes hold 1.5 s / press twice (setting in ui/game_settings.gd); idle screens (display only); onboarding glow and hint; use(station, action) as the single decision entry.

AC8: make ship-console-test (all stations load; every active station has a non-empty WalkArea.path from the bridge spawn; prompt only in reach and facing)

features.notes: demos/ship_consoles.gd: 6 stations from ship.glb names; use points a step back from each console edge, within 2.5 m; walked paths from spawn: navigation 19.6 m, voyage 15.2 m, archive 17.1 m (40 m ceiling). E priority incl. the lift; reach 2.5 m + facing 60 deg prompt; 0.6 s dolly to a pose framing the station idle screen, back on E/Esc; panels (helm full width, voyage compact left, archive with codex over); click-to-walk + Tab Walk to (keyboard focus ring), 3.5 m/s, WASD cancels; confirm hold 1.5 s / press twice (GameSettings.confirm_mode), no deadlines; idle screens (SubViewport labels on the console faces, display only); onboarding glow + hint on menu launches until the first use. use(station, action) is the single entry. make ship-console-test 80 checks green.

features.description: Own-day spike: embed GalaxyMap (native Window, force_native, own_world_3d, own window_input) in the console panel, or fall back to a borderless window over the console rect; make ship-ui-window-check runs the chosen host in a real GPU window (open, click-select, hold-commit).
acceptance_criteria: AC15: make ship-ui-window-check green in a GPU window
features.notes: Chosen host: GalaxyMap in an embedded borderless Window (force_native false, own_world_3d, own input) laid over the navigation panel; content_scale_factor fits the map panel to the host. tools/ship_ui_window_check.gd + make ship-ui-window-check: green in a GPU window (embedded=true; real OS-level click selects Barnard's Star; click Commit opens the dialog; 1.65 s real hold commits). Viewport.push_input into an embedded window does not reach its GUI; the check uses Input.parse_input_event at screen pixels, the real path. The check found a real bug: a star plan made before the hold went stale_plan (the ship at rest moves with Earth); GalaxyMap now re-plans in the commit tick when the ship has moved since the plan.

features.description: On the host U4a chose. GalaxyMap.mode chart/helm: chart (M, I-card Open in map) has no slider, commit, cancel, Return to Sol, in-system list or Sgr A* entry and never pauses the tour; selection carries to the helm. Helm hosts commit, cancel, Sgr A* entry; at Sgr A* the stop ladder with Approach and Leave (confirm).
acceptance_criteria: AC9 (helm part): make ship-console-test (helm commit sends the same intent as today's map commit; Approach/Leave equal bh_next_stop()/leave_black_hole())
features.notes: GalaxyMap.mode chart/helm; planning() gate (helm and not guided). Chart: banner, no slider/commit/cancel/home/in-system/Sgr A* entry, never plans (so no plan preview: NT1 over §D), never pauses the tour; selection carries to the helm (planned there unless already the plan). Outside the helm the map rests in chart mode. Helm: commit (hold or press twice: GalaxyMap.confirm_twice/armed/confirm_press), cancel, Return to Sol, In this system, Sgr A* entry; at Sgr A* the stop ladder with Approach and Leave (confirm). M = chart; I-card Open in map = chart.
